description: Each station's average bandwidth usage is compared against the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.

a.request: For each observatory station (`observstation`), compute the average bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of its telescopes, ignoring missing values. Compute the overall average across all individual telescopes, so stations with more telescopes weigh more. Keep only the stations whose average is above this overall average. Show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how far it is above the overall average (station average minus overall average). Sort by that difference from largest to smallest and return the top 10, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: Compare each observatory station's average telescope `bandusagepct` (grouped by `observstation`, ignoring nulls) against the overall mean `bandusagepct` across all individual telescope records. Return the top 10 stations whose average exceeds that overall mean, ordered by the unrounded margin (station average minus overall mean) from largest to smallest
b.sql: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS margin FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding. Each station's average bandwidth usage is compared against the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.
c.sql: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS excess_over_overall FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) that is above the overall average bandwidth usage, where the overall average is the mean of `bandusagepct` across all individual telescope records (not the average of the station averages)? Ignore missing values. For each such station, show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding.
d.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_all FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_usage AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_usage - o.avg_all AS margin_above_overall FROM station s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_all ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
